# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low volatility (ATR contraction), a breakout with expanding volume signals a sustainable directional move. The edge exists because low volatility periods often precede institutional participation, and volume-confirmed breakouts with aligned short-to-intermediate-term EMAs indicate genuine momentum rather than false breakouts caused by liquidity grabs or news spikes.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the 20-period ATR is below its 50-period average (volatility contraction) AND price closes above the upper Bollinger Band (20,2) for long [or below lower band for short] AND volume on the breakout candle is > 1.5x the 20-period average volume AND the EMA ribbon (8,21,55) is aligned in the breakout direction (for long: EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55; for short: EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55). Exit: Initial stop at the opposite Bollinger Band (or 20-period EMA if band width < 0.1% of price, making the band too tight), target at 2x risk or trail with chandelier exit (3x ATR multiplier). Only trades between 9:30-11:30 ET when VIX < 15.
